say:3:1810773201:0.source_cn: 我……我的记忆……我想起来了……<key:dialog2>

say:4:1810773202:0.text: Estrilda, Thane... I'm sorry. I actually forgot the two of you...
say:4:1810773202:0.source_cn: 爱丝，瑟恩……抱歉，我竟然忘记了你们……

say:6:1810773204:1.text: It's enough that you're back. How do you feel?

say:7:1810773205:1.text: My body doesn't quite feel like my own. It's so... cold. If you're asking how I feel emotionally, it's complicated.
say:7:1810773205:1.source_cn: 身体好像不是自己的，很……冰冷。如果你是指心情……的确...

say:8:1810773206:1.text: But don't worry. You know me, I've always been an optimist. Even a situation like this, I can deal with.
say:8:1810773206:1.source_cn: 不过别担心，你知道的，我向来是个很乐观的家伙。就算是现...

say:9:1810773207:1.text: Looking the way you do now, I'm afraid you'll never be able to return to Ashvale County or the Lightbearer Empire.
say:9:1810773207:1.source_cn: 以你现在的模样，恐怕再也无法回到耀光帝国和灰影郡了。

say:10:1810773208:1.text: Yeah. But... this was the best choice available to me.
say:10:1810773208:1.source_cn: 是啊，不过……这已经是我力所能及的最好选择。

say:11:1810773209:1.text: If Baba Muriel had sacrificed herself to save me, the guilt would have been unbearable...
say:11:1810773209:1.source_cn: 如果为了保全我而牺牲穆婆婆，我只会背负起更沉重的负担，...

say:12:1810773210:1.text: Thank you for letting go, Thane... I know this hurts you more than it hurts me.
say:12:1810773210:1.source_cn: 谢谢你当时没有阻拦我，瑟恩……我知道你心里一定比我更难过。

say:14:1810773212:1.text: Then I would have saved you too. Even without my memories, I still would've saved you.
say:14:1810773212:1.source_cn: 那我也会去救你。即使我没有过去的记忆，也依然会救你。

say:17:1810773213:1.text: Hmph! And I would've stopped you, foolish boy!

say:18:1810773214:1.text: Ha... You'd find it pretty hard to hold me back, Baba.

say:20:1810773216:0.text: By the way, how are things in Ashvale County? Who's commanding the army?
say:20:1810773216:0.source_cn: 对了，灰影郡现在的战况如何？你和爱丝都跑到诺珐斯来了，...

say:23:1810773217:1.text: Sorry. After Thane left, I couldn't just sit at home and wait.
say:23:1810773217:1.source_cn: 对不起。瑟恩离开后，我实在没法安心待在灰影郡干等着。<...

say:24:1810773218:1.text: So... I abandoned my post and came after him. But don't worry! I handled everything I could think of before leaving!
say:24:1810773218:1.source_cn: 所以……我就擅自离岗了。但你不用担心，我把能想到的事情...

say:25:1810773219:1.text: Estrilda gives Baden a quick summary of the defensive arrangements she made before departing.
say:25:1810773219:1.source_cn: 爱丝特瑞达向巴登简单叙述了一遍她的安排。<key:di...

say:26:1810773220:1.text: Well done, Estrilda. You've grown into a real leader. House Rayne is in good hands.
say:26:1810773220:1.source_cn: 干得好，爱丝……你比以前稳重了很多。不愧是我们瑞恩家族...

say:27:1810773221:1.text: After what I did, I no longer deserve to be head. I should be punished.
say:27:1810773221:1.source_cn: 我这样的行为已不配再为家主，理应受罚。

say:28:1810773222:1.text: Worse... I failed to protect you, and you became a Graveborn...
say:28:1810773222:1.source_cn: 不仅如此……我还没能保住你的性命，让你变成了亡灵……

say:30:1810773224:1.text:
You've done more than enough, Estrilda.
What happened to me has nothing to do with you or Thane.
say:30:1810773224:1.source_cn: 你已经做得很好了，爱丝。\n我变成亡灵，和你、和瑟恩，...

say:31:1810773225:1.text: In my absence, the two of you continued protecting our home. Even if war comes again, the peace our people have today is precious.
say:31:1810773225:1.source_cn: 我离开后，是你和瑟恩一直在守护着灰影郡。即便日后还要开...

say:32:1810773226:1.text: You're the pride of the Rayne family. I couldn't be prouder.
say:32:1810773226:1.source_cn: 你是瑞恩家族的骄傲，我为你的成长而自豪。

say:33:1810773227:1.text: ... I'm not a child anymore. Stop trying to cheer me up with that line.
say:33:1810773227:1.source_cn: ……我已经不是小孩了，你不要总拿这句话来哄我。

say:34:1810773228:1.text: As you command, Miss Rayne. I'm not very good at comforting people, but if the family head orders it, I'll do my best to make you smile.
say:34:1810773228:1.source_cn: 遵命，瑞恩小姐。我确实不会哄人，但只要你以家主身份下令...

say:36:1810773230:1.text: Don't be sad, Estrilda. Don't you think my current body makes me the perfect spy?
say:36:1810773230:1.source_cn: 别难过啦，爱丝。你不觉得我现在这个状态，很适合潜入班题...

say:37:1810773231:1.text: Since I can't return to Ashvale County and I can't stay here, I might as well head into enemy territory and dig up their secrets.
say:37:1810773231:1.source_cn: 既然回不去灰影郡，也不能呆在诺珐斯，不如深入敌方腹地，...

say:41:1810773233:0.text: A soft, melodic laugh echoes through the room as Tephesia suddenly appears beside you.
say:41:1810773233:0.source_cn: 伴随着轻快的笑声，苔佩希的身影忽然出现在了你身边。<k...
say:41:1810773233:0.male: A soft, melodic laugh echoes through the room as Tephesia suddenly appears beside you.
say:41:1810773233:0.female: A soft, melodic laugh echoes through the room as Tephesia suddenly appears beside you.

say:42:1810773234:0.text: A spy, hmm? Now that's a delightful idea.
say:42:1810773234:0.source_cn: 当间谍啊……多么刺激的一个想法。

say:43:1810773235:0.text: In that case, take a look at this intel my messenger just delivered. It may prove useful.
say:43:1810773235:0.source_cn: 那么，看看余的信使送来的这份情报吧。也许会对你有所助益。
